principles: Only fix the observed correctness issue; do not optimize DONE broadly.
Preserve materialHash/storyFilesHash safety and fail closed on real drift.
Keep Lattice workflow host-neutral; recovery commands must not be Codex/Claude specific.
drivers: B-3523 showed repeated stale-recovery loops during DONE closure.
done_prepare already contains the intended safe sequencing.
Moving version bump before DONE would violate existing requirements.

options.name: A: Route ordering-sensitive DONE blockers through done_prepare hints
pros: Does not weaken gates or move version bump
cons: It improves recovery guidance rather than making raw DONE run every recovery step automatically

options.name: B: Make story_advance DONE run done_prepare internally
cons: Adds hidden mutation and validation work inside DONE
Higher risk of long-running or surprising DONE attempts

options.name: C: Move version/dist finalization before final evidence
pros: Would make some post-DONE hashes align earlier
cons: Version bump changes material hash before DONE
High risk and not necessary for the observed recovery loop

chosen: A: Route ordering-sensitive DONE blockers through done_prepare hints
rationale: Option A fixes the actual operator/agent recovery loop by converging scattered stale/sync hints onto the existing ordered done_prepare command, while preserving all freshness gates and keeping version/dist finalization post-DONE.

preMortem.scenario: Hint-only change fails to cover the stale loop
preMortem.trigger: DONE blockers still print git merge main or done_required_validate as primary recovery
preMortem.consequence: Agents manually stitch commands together and repeat stale evidence work
preMortem.mitigation: Regression smoke asserts branch sync and DONE-required blockers expose done_prepare as the next command

preMortem.scenario: Change weakens safety by hiding real material drift
preMortem.trigger: A stale command-backed or material-drift evidence record is treated as pass
preMortem.consequence: DONE could proceed on unverified material
preMortem.mitigation: Do not change freshness predicates; only change recovery hints/nextCommand routing

preMortem.scenario: Version bump moves into pre-DONE work
preMortem.trigger: Implementation tries to satisfy final evidence by bumping version before DONE
preMortem.consequence: materialHash changes and evidence becomes stale by design
preMortem.mitigation: Keep version bump code unchanged and document that done_prepare remains pre-DONE only
